sections.Profile:
Released in November 1950 "Joker" is an electro-mechanical machine designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. It features two flippers, four pop bumpers, and a card-playing theme.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Poker, Wood Rail, Gambling, Card games, Original Theme
